answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 34965 Country: India Title: I have kids. Can I add their name to my father's name? Question: I have kids. Can I add their name to my father's name? Like my name is Tariq and my kids are Faaris and Ayaan. Can I add to Faaris Aijaz and Ayaan Aijaz. Answer ID: 34965 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1648/1128/L=1432) The name of father may be attached with the names of children. There is no harm in it as per the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
